title: Coach Capacity Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Calculate the number of coaches a rollout needs, rounding up, and the number of teachers a given number of coaches can support.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the number of coaches needed for a given number of teachers and coach capacity, and the number of teachers a given number of coaches can support, correctly answering three of three questions.
prerequisites: Scaling a pilot, instructional coaching, coach capacity, and rounding up, from the section "Scaling Without Breaking" in Chapter 21 and from Chapter 19.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit answers before the results unlock, then explore the inputs
keyQuestions: How many coaches does the rollout need?
How many teachers can the coaches you have support?
commonMisconceptions: Coaches needed can be a fraction.
Scaling speed depends only on the software.
A thinner coach load has no effect.
assessmentOpportunities: 400 teachers at 12 per coach. How many coaches?
Can the coaches needed be a fraction?
Does buying more software licenses speed up the rollout?

controls.name: Answer box and Check
controls.description: Type a number and check it. Two tries per question.

controls.name: Next question / See the results
controls.description: Moves on after a question is finished.

controls.name: Three sliders
controls.description: Teachers to support (10 to 600), teachers per coach (6 to 20), and coaches available (1 to 50). They unlock after the questions.

controls.name: Defaults
controls.description: Puts the sliders back to 150 teachers, 12 per coach, and 8 coaches.

controls.name: Start over
controls.description: Returns to Question 1 and locks the sliders.
